abstract: A 34-year-old woman visited our hospital complaining of dry cough. Chest radiography and computed tomography showed bilateral multiple infiltrative shadows over the lung field. After an initial diagnosis of pneumonia, antibiotics were administered, but the therapy failed to improve the symptoms and abnormalities observed on the chest radiograph. The patient was then admitted to our hospital. The bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF) was slightly bloody, but we were not able to make any specific findings in BALF. In order to confirm the pathological diagnosis, video-assisted thoracoscopic lung biopsy was performed aiming at the right middle and lower lobes. There were bleeding pulmonary infarctions in a biopsy specimen from the right middle lobe. Atypical cells positive for human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) proliferated in the pulmonary arteries, and so a diagnosis of pulmonary embolic metastasis of choriocarcinoma was made. After the diagnosis, it became clear that urine and serum hCG values were very high. The patient has since received systemic chemotherapy in the gynecology unit at our hospital. Pulmonary embolic metastasis of choriocarcinoma diagnosed by video-assisted thoracoscopic lung biopsy has never been reported in the literature. However, early hCG measurement may have detected this syndrome in the earlier stages, and pulmonary metastasis of choriocarcinoma should be considered in the differential diagnosis of women with past pregnancy presenting with intractable multiple pulmonary shadows.
abstract_ja: 34歳の女性が乾性咳嗽を主訴に当院を受診した。胸部単純X線検査およびコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で、両肺野に多発する浸潤影が認められた。当初は肺炎と診断され抗菌薬が投与されたが、症状および胸部X線所見は改善しなかった。その後当院に入院となった。気管支肺胞洗浄液(BALF)はわずかに血性であったが、BALFで特異的な所見は得られなかった。病理学的診断を確定するため、右中葉および下葉を対象に胸腔鏡下肺生検を施行した。右中葉の生検検体には出血性肺梗塞像が認められた。肺動脈内にヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)陽性の異型細胞が増殖しており、絨毛癌の肺動脈塞栓性転移と診断された。診断後、尿中および血清hCG値が著しく高値であることが判明した。患者は当院婦人科で全身化学療法を受けている。胸腔鏡下肺生検で診断された絨毛癌の肺動脈塞栓性転移は、これまで報告がない。しかし、早期のhCG測定により、より早い段階でこの症候群を発見できた可能性がある。既往妊娠のある女性で難治性の多発肺陰影を呈する場合には、絨毛癌の肺転移を鑑別診断に含めるべきである。
